name: read_outline
description: Read a structured outline of a source file: hierarchical function/class/method signatures, line numbers, reference counts. Uses the pre-indexed symbols table (call reindex first). Returns truncated=true if max_items exceeded. Token estimate based on file size. Note: depth here means hierarchy nesting depth (0=top-level only, 1=class+methods), NOT call chain depth. For call chain depth, use call_chain or impact_analysis.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory. Call reindex first.

include_refs.description: Include reference counts per symbol (default: false)
